name: permission-grid
title: Permission Grid
description: Spec-sheet grid of capabilities: one row per tool with mark, state and scope.

.caps-permission-grid.border:
var(--border) solid
      color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-base-content) 22%, var(--color-base-100))

.caps-permission-grid-caption.borderBottom:
var(--border) solid
      color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-base-content) 22%, var(--color-base-100))

.caps-permission-grid thead th.borderBottom:
var(--border) solid
      color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-base-content) 22%, var(--color-base-100))

.caps-permission-grid tbody td,.caps-per.borderBottom:
var(--border) dashed
      color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-base-content) 14%, var(--color-base-100))
